categories.title: Hide Reels
categories.detail: When enabled, the Reels tab is removed and the Reels rail is cut from the feed.

categories.title: Hide Search and Explore
categories.detail: When enabled, the Search tab is removed and the Explore grid is cut from the search page.

categories.title: Hide suggested posts
categories.detail: When enabled, Suggested for you posts and account carousels are cut from the feed.

categories.title: Hide ads
categories.detail: When enabled, Sponsored posts are cut from the feed and ad and tracking requests are blocked.

categories.title: Hide stories
categories.detail: When enabled, the stories tray is removed from the top of the feed.
